relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: The variant in SCN9A was demonstrated to abrogate normal subcellular localization and function of the encoded Na(v)1.7 (Cox et al., 2010).

relationships.subject: PRDM12
relationships.evidence_quote: PRDM12 functions as a transcriptional regulator, which is important in the differentiation from a neural crest cell to a precursor sensory neuron

key_findings: Novel homozygous PRDM12 variant p.Ala152Asp found in CIP patients
PRDM12-variant patients had more severe ocular surface disease than SCN9A (R896Q) patients
